bios.label: Short bio
bios.text: Joe Hart is a web engineer and comedian who loves making joyous and charming things. Joe has built front-ends at Monzo, the BBC and LEGO, and spends spare time rebuilding classic video games in tools that were never meant for them.

bios.label: Long bio
bios.text: Joe Hart is a web engineer and comedian who loves making joyous and charming things. Joe has built front-ends at Monzo, the BBC, LEGO and a bunch of startups, and spends spare time rebuilding classic video games like Age of Empires 2 and Final Fantasy IX in React, a tool that was never meant for them. Joe's talks sit somewhere between a tech talk and a comedy set, and have been seen at React Advanced London, JSWORLD, Brighton Ruby, Front End North and HalfStack. Joe also hosts podcasts and makes silly games at joehart.co.uk.
